Package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service

Class PinRepository

java.lang.Object
edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.PinRepository
@Singleton public class PinRepository extends Object
Repository class to manage data operations related to Pins and Tracks. Provides methods to interact with the persistence layer through DAOs and integrates with the Google Sign-In service for user-specific operations. Utilizes dependency injection for instantiation and RxJava for handling asynchronous operations.

  • Method Details

    • save

      public Single<Pin> save(Pin pin)
      Saves the specified Pin object to the database. If the pin already exists (determined by a nonzero ID), it updates the existing record and sets the modification timestamp to the current time. Otherwise, it inserts the new Pin into the database.
      Parameters:
      pin - The Pin object to be saved or updated. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A Single<Pin> representing the saved or updated Pin object.

    • get

      public LiveData<Pin> get(long id)
      Retrieves a Pin object identified by the specified unique ID from the database.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier of the Pin to fetch. Must be a positive number.
      Returns:
      A LiveData<Pin> instance representing the Pin entity with the given ID.

    • remove

      public Completable remove(Pin pin)
      Deletes the specified Pin object from the database. This operation is asynchronous and will execute on the specified scheduler.
      Parameters:
      pin - The Pin object to be removed from the database. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A Completable representing the result of the delete operation. It completes successfully when the Pin is deleted or emits an error if the operation fails.

      public LiveData<List<Pin>> getAll(User user)
